author.name: Data Dave
author.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

challenge.name: The Silent Store Gap
challenge.description: A batch of till scan lines from the northern stores was silently dropped during last night's ingestion, causing the model to forecast zero demand for fresh produce. #reliability_ruth# argues that the ingestion pipeline must be fully automated to guarantee every store's data arrives on time, while #data_dave# is willing to accept a manual verification step to ensure data quality before it reaches the feature store.

output.content: I want the validation step for incoming till scan lines to be done by hand before the data enters the feature store. I am not asking for a full automation of this specific check right now, but I do want that manual review to happen every single night without exception. If we can add a second pair of eyes to the northern stores batch, that would be even better. I am looking for a process where no store is ever skipped, and I am happy to expand that manual effort to include a spot check of the goods receipts as well. The more stores we verify by hand, the more confident I am that we will not see another zero forecast for fresh produce.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly states that increasing the scope of manual verification (adding a second pair of eyes or spot-checking receipts) would result in greater confidence, indicating that doing more than the minimum requested aligns with the author's goals.
